question: India's longest LPG pipeline is from Jamnagar to _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Loni**__.

__
 
• **India's longest LPG pipeline is from Jamnagar to Loni**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The LPG pipeline is the longest in the world.
 
 
• It is India's first cross-country pipeline.
 
• It passes through Gujarat, Rajasthan, Haryana, Delhi, UP. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hazira-Vijaipur-Jagsishpur **(HVJ) is India's first cross-state gas pipeline.

 
 
• The project was started in 1986.
 
• **States**: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Haryana, Delhi, UP, Madhya Pradesh
 
 
 
• **Namrup** is a small town situated close to Patkai hills in the extreme southeastern part of Assam, India.
 
 
• Namrup Thermal Power Plant is situated in Assam.
